bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are preparing for a pivotal Thanksgiving Day showdown against the Detroit Lions in Week 12 after improving to 8-2 and extending their win streak to five with a 21-13 victory over the New Orleans Saints, a game in which Jeffery Simmons recorded three sacks, tying his single-game career high. Meanwhile, the Bears' Monday injury report showed cornerback Kyler Gordon among several non-participants heading into the Lions matchup, while off the field the team continues navigating roster moves and pressure surrounding their stadium decision.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions' defense took another hit Tuesday when coach Dan Campbell revealed that rookie defensive tackle Skyler Gill-Howard is out for the rest of the season with a knee injury sustained during the team's win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. This comes as the team continues dealing with a mounting injury list on that side of the ball, with injuries to the Detroit Lions defense starting to mount ahead of their Thanksgiving Day matchup against the Chicago Bears.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers have officially activated star edge rusher Micah Parsons off the PUP list, clearing him to return for Wednesday's pivotal Thanksgiving Eve matchup against the Los Angeles Rams. Packers EDGE Micah Parsons has officially been activated off the PUP List, with the star ready to go against the Rams , while the team also faces a key absence as Josh Jacobs (finger) is not expected to play in the Rams-Packers Thanksgiving Eve showdown .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest recent storyline centers on the Vikings' up-and-down stretch following their blockbuster trade for Kirk Cousins. The Minnesota Vikings enter this week still processing the emotional swings of their season, having looked like Super Bowl contenders with a dominant win over Green Bay just days after reacquiring Kirk Cousins from the Raiders, only to get flown to Mexico City and punched in the mouth by the San Francisco 49ers the following week, leaving fans wondering if they're even in the same class as the NFC's elite teams .
